paper.title: Guided Self-Evolving LLMs with Minimal Human Supervision
paper.central_claim: 少量人类anchor以few-shot生成和混合在线课程稳定自演化，使少标注RL模型接近大量人类数据训练的推理模型。

reason: 全文及附录A.1–A.4已读。Challenger经SFT/GRPO、Solver经GRPO迭代改权重；anchor池和prompt是预设输入，筛题供训练，没有评价执行反馈演化并留存的非权重组件。冻结A3排除。
rationale: Few-shot示例指导训练题生成；被评价的留存产物是Challenger/Solver权重，而非prompt或memory。范围外，分数null。

sections_read: Appendix A.1–A.4 complete training details, hyperparameters, prompts, judge configuration

evidence.quote: The Challenger parameters are updated via GRPO as:
we added a quick warm-up stage via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to help it reliably adhere to the required format.

At each iteration, the Challenger samples a small set of human-labeled examples to guide synthetic question generation, while the Solver jointly trains on human and synthetic examples under an online, difficulty-based curriculum.
evidence.support_explanation: anchor是固定生成输入和训练数据

evidence.quote: reaches 55.1 with 1% data and 56.7 with 5%, surpassing General-Reasoner (56.0).
The challenger and solver are trained iteratively, with the challenger updated for 5 steps followed by 10 steps of solver training.
these are actually equal, don’t mark them equivalent if you need to do nontrivial simplifications

claims.text: 少量人类监督稳定共演化并接近全量训练
claims.setting: Qwen3-4B/8B；5数学+4通用基准，GPT-4o数学judge，通用greedy EM；solver100/challenger50步
claims.baseline_control: base/R-Zero同基础设施；AbsoluteZero/SPICE外部报告；GeneralReasoner232k全数据；三个组件消融
claims.selection_vs_test: 混合题训练→公开benchmark测更新权重；无非权重产物冻结迁移测试
claims.result_denominator: 8B总均值R-Zero53.7、R-Few1%55.1/5%56.7、GeneralReasoner56.0；九benchmark均值非显著性。表2去Challenger训练下降3.0/1.5与正文1.9/1.0不一致。
